clauses.clause: Dogs: 1.1× run, ≥ 0.6 s telegraph, ≤ 2 m reach, ≥ 2 s cooldown, 10 HP/bite; low, distinct from the corgi.
clauses.note: Current native low/high dog mechanics: speed ratio1.1, real hit reach1.08m,10HP damage,0.65s telegraph,2s hit-to-next-windup cooldown. Four current-source physical encounters restore naturally reached dog/corgi saves with no actor writes; only cameraZoom changes. Personally inspected all42 final frames and46 initial rejected-matrix frames. The first high-wide named frames obscured the dog, so that matrix was not admitted. Capture policy now records wide approach at<=12m before the crowd converges, keeping close<=3m; all four cells were remeasured under the new producer hash. Named witnesses show cream/brown low canine torso/muzzle/legs/tail and red enemy bar, distinct from orange/white round-headed backpack corgi at both zooms/tiers. Close high has partial crowd occlusion; new wide views show a separate living silhouette. Actual runtime quality/zoom, no skips/deaths or console/page errors; native snapshot controls unchanged. These are short appearance encounters, not full physical finale completion.
